_comment: Labelled retrieval eval. 'expected' lists file-name prefixes of every paper that genuinely answers the question (verified against paper text). A query is a hit if any expected paper appears in the top-k results. 'hard' queries are paraphrased in plain language and avoid each paper's distinctive terms (e.g. no 'rTMS', 'eMTBR', 'NULISA'), so they test semantic matching rather than keyword overlap.
